lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you went down ta get the mail? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well I called Travis first.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You called Travis first. (Brendan nods “yes”) OK. How long did ya talk to Travis?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: ‘bout ten, fifteen minutes

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And after you’re done talkin’ to Travis, what did you do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Went out to go get the mail

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And did you take a bike like you said?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And then you’re coming back from the mail, is is that when you, tell me what happened then again?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That’s when I went to get the mail and I came back, I was lookin’ at it when I was riding the bike and I seen Steven’s mail in there and I went over by him and I knocked on the door.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK and you heard stuff coming from there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) mm huh

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Again, what did you hear coming from there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Screaming like help me and that

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK and then you said before you knocked on his door.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) uh huh

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you said you had ta knock

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: three times (nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: three times and it took how long for Steven to get to the door about?
